# Oliv AI Documentation V1 Review

> Draft; not approved production documentation. This index is optional and makes no crawler-access or citation guarantee.

- [Oliv AI product documentation](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/): Explore Oliv AI agents, setup flows, integrations, seven revenue domains, ICP guides and the complete buyer and AI evaluation maps.
- [Evidence and claims workbench](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/evaluation/): Filter all 555 buyer criteria and 91 AI checks by evidence, claim status, weight and capability group. Every criterion links to its detailed reference.
- [Getting started](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/getting-started/): Choose a first use case, connect the right systems and establish a review process before expanding agent activity.
- [Plan your first deployment](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/getting-started/implementation/): Define the use case, owners, inputs, review controls and acceptance checks for an Oliv deployment.
- [Connect your revenue stack](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/getting-started/connect-your-stack/): Identify which CRM, calendar, recording and collaboration connections a workflow needs.
- [Run a first workflow](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/getting-started/first-workflow/): Establish a controlled first Oliv workflow and verify its source, output and review boundary.
- [Who uses Oliv](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/getting-started/roles/): Understand the jobs Oliv serves across sales development, sales, CS, account management, enablement and RevOps.
- [Startups and staged adoption](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/getting-started/startups/): Plan a staged revenue-stack deployment without assuming an organization-wide replacement.
- [Assess deployment readiness](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/getting-started/readiness/): Name the sponsor, process owner, system administrators and daily reviewers before connecting data.
- [Inventory revenue data](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/getting-started/data-inventory/): List the records, interactions and process documents needed for the first workflow, with explicit source ownership.
- [Validate account and user identity](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/getting-started/identity-mapping/): Reliable account, opportunity and user mapping is a prerequisite for source-grounded automation.
- [Configure methodology and stage definitions](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/getting-started/methodology/): Use approved process definitions to align qualification, CRM fields and agent interpretation.
- [Approve an action policy](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/getting-started/approval-policy/): Separate reading context, generating a proposal and executing an external action in the deployment policy.
- [Validate recording readiness](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/getting-started/recording-readiness/): Meeting capture depends on permitted access, organizational setup and meeting-specific conditions.
- [Configure notification ownership](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/getting-started/notifications/): Useful alerts require correct recipients, cadence and an escalation route.
- [Run a pilot acceptance review](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/getting-started/pilot-acceptance/): Review end-to-end behavior using permitted examples, exceptions and a written record of findings.
- [Plan reviewer training and adoption](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/getting-started/training-adoption/): Teach users how to inspect evidence, correct outputs and own the final customer or system action.
- [Expand a reviewed workflow](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/getting-started/rollout/): Expand only after the original workflow has clear ownership, evidence quality and known limits.
- [Plan migration and historical backfill](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/getting-started/migration-backfill/): Historical import and migration scope require a source-specific technical and service contract.
- [Plan revocation and offboarding](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/getting-started/offboarding/): Disconnecting a source, deactivating a user and deleting retained data are distinct lifecycle actions.
- [Buyer, ICP and evaluation guides](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/buyers/): Understand ideal-fit signals, the buying committee, company-stage scenarios and the complete 735-question buyer universe.
- [Buying committee and user roles](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/buyers/roles/): Map economic buyers, champions, daily users and risk approvers to the decisions they own.
- [Chief Revenue Officer evaluation guide](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/buyers/roles/cro/): Forecast confidence, pipeline quality and aligned sales-to-CS execution.
- [VP of Sales evaluation guide](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/buyers/roles/vp-sales/): Repeatable deal execution and manager visibility without rebuilding every status report.
- [Head of Revenue Operations evaluation guide](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/buyers/roles/revops/): Reliable CRM data, consistent definitions, auditable automation and manageable administration.
- [Head of Customer Success evaluation guide](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/buyers/roles/head-cs/): Clear renewal exposure, account priorities and an accountable expansion handoff.
- [Sales Manager evaluation guide](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/buyers/roles/sales-manager/): Useful pipeline reviews and evidence-based coaching between recurring 1:1s.
- [Account Executive evaluation guide](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/buyers/roles/account-executive/): Prepare customer meetings, keep commitments current and review proposed CRM changes.
- [SDR and BDR evaluation guide](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/buyers/roles/sdr-bdr/): Prioritized research and appropriate outreach with clear qualification and handoff.
- [Sales Engineer evaluation guide](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/buyers/roles/sales-engineer/): Accessible deal history, technical requirements and agreed next actions.
- [Account Manager evaluation guide](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/buyers/roles/account-manager/): Relationship continuity, clear account priorities and timely expansion opportunities.
- [Customer Success Manager evaluation guide](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/buyers/roles/csm/): Current customer context, actionable risks and a reliable handoff when growth potential appears.
- [CFO and Finance evaluation guide](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/buyers/roles/finance/): Defensible total cost, forecast accountability and clear contractual exposure.
- [IT, Security and Legal evaluation guide](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/buyers/roles/it-security/): A documented data boundary, least-privilege access and current security evidence.
- [Company-stage and ICP planning](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/buyers/stages/): Use the master’s company-stage context to plan scope and adoption without treating historical size bands as eligibility rules.
- [SMB and startup planning guide](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/buyers/stages/startup/): Founder-led or small revenue teams need fast, focused adoption with clear ownership.
- [Growth stage planning guide](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/buyers/stages/growth/): Growing teams need consistent process without adding administrative effort at every handoff.
- [Mid-market planning guide](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/buyers/stages/mid-market/): Multiple managers and teams need reliable definitions, governance and cross-team visibility.
- [Enterprise evaluation planning guide](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/buyers/stages/enterprise/): Complex organizations need a verified data boundary, scalable ownership and contractual clarity.
- [Role and company-stage scenarios](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/buyers/scenarios/): Apply the master’s core role-by-stage framework to concrete evaluation and adoption decisions.

- [Seven revenue domains](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/domains/): Use the master document’s seven-domain framework to connect buyer needs, Oliv’s source-described scope, relevant agents and validation requirements.
- [Sales Development domain](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/domains/sales-development/): Understand sales development buyer jobs, relevant Oliv agents and the boundaries that need confirmation.
- [Sales Development: Account and contact research](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/domains/sales-development/account-contact-research/): Researcher describes account and contact preparation; current sources also describe research-assisted prospecting.
- [Sales Development: Intent and buying signals](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/domains/sales-development/intent-and-signals/): The master connects outreach timing to account signals. Specific third-party intent feeds and scoring contracts require confirmation.
- [Sales Development: Sequencing and outreach](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/domains/sales-development/sequencing/): Engage and Prospector describe research-assisted outreach. Current sending limits, approval controls and channels require workspace verification.
- [Sales Development: Dialing and phone engagement](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/domains/sales-development/dialing/): The revised master discusses calling. Uncapped dialing, unrestricted countries and legal coverage are not verified commitments.
- [Sales Development: AI-assisted prospecting](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/domains/sales-development/ai-prospecting/): Prospector prepares account outreach; automation progression in the master is an illustrative operating model.
- [Sales Development: Inbound qualification and routing](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/domains/sales-development/inbound-routing/): Quick Qualifier and Rapid Responder appear in current public product narratives. Exact routing rules and service commitments remain open.
- [Sales and deal execution domain](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/domains/sales/): Understand sales and deal execution buyer jobs, relevant Oliv agents and the boundaries that need confirmation.
- [Sales and deal execution: CRM complement and system of record](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/domains/sales/crm-complement/): Oliv is positioned as a context and action layer alongside the existing CRM. The standalone-CRM passages in the master are superseded.
- [Sales and deal execution: Recording and transcription](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/domains/sales/conversation-capture/): Converse and Context Capture describe interaction capture. The May 2026 recording guide qualifies native and bot modes by meeting conditions.
- [Sales and deal execution: Conversation intelligence](https://maximuslabs-ai.github.io/oliv-ai-product-docs/domains/sales/conversation-intelligence/): Conversation evidence supports summaries, coaching and downstream deal work. Exact language and channel coverage needs confirmation.
